submission.workflow_yaml:
name: v2336-combined
on: push

# Tests multiple v2.336.0 features in a single workflow:
# - GITHUB_ARTIFACTS file commands
# - ACTIONS_CACHE_MODE env var
# - Step execution with continue-on-error (background cancel analog)
# - GITHUB_ENV / GITHUB_OUTPUT / GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY (regression)

jobs:
  combined:
    runs-on: self-hosted
    steps:
      # 1. File command env vars are present
      - name: Verify file command env vars
        run: |
          for var in GITHUB_ENV GITHUB_OUTPUT GITHUB_PATH GITHUB_STATE GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY GITHUB_ARTIFACTS GITHUB_ARTIFACTS_LIST; do
            val=$(eval echo "\$$var")
            echo "$var=$val"
          done

      # 2. Cross-step env propagation
      - name: Set env
        run: echo "V2336_COMBINED=combined-ok" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Check env
        run: test "$V2336_COMBINED" = "combined-ok"

      # 3. Output propagation
      - name: Set output
        id: producer
        run: echo "result=42" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Read output
        run: |
          echo "Producer result: ${{ steps.producer.outputs.result }}"
          test "${{ steps.producer.outputs.result }}" = "42"

      # 4. continue-on-error (background step cancel analog)
      - name: Failing step with continue-on-error
        continue-on-error: true
        run: exit 1

      - name: After soft failure
        run: echo "still-running-after-soft-fail"

      # 5. PATH additions
      - name: Add to PATH
        run: echo "/tmp/v2336-test-bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Verify PATH
        run: echo "$PATH" | grep -q "v2336-test-bin"

      # 6. State file command
      - name: Set state
        run: echo "saved=state-value" >> "$GITHUB_STATE"

      # 7. Step summary
      - name: Write step summary
        run: |
          echo "### v2.336.0 Combined Test" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "All checks passed." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      # 8. Artifact file (if enabled)
      - name: Write artifact entry
        run: |
          echo "test-subject sha256:deadbeef" >> "$GITHUB_ARTIFACTS" 2>/dev/null || true

      # 9. Final check
      - name: All v2336 checks passed
        run: echo "ALL_V2336_COMBINED_CHECKS_PASSED"
